mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we are enjoying clear skies under a full moon at Verona Community Park with temperatures around 75 degrees. The air quality index is currently 55, so keep that in mind if you are heading out. We are looking at a quiet night with an overnight low of 62 degrees and no rain expected.

The city is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest to get students involved in the election process. Voters in November will be using stickers designed by local students from grades K-12. You can view the designs and cast your vote online through August 7 at the city website.

Tonight, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the fun continues with the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, plus yoga and more trivia nights at local venues.

In a report covering July 20 to July 27, officers dealt with a variety of calls. On Wednesday, July 23, officers were dispatched to Lucerne Drive where a 23-year-old man was arrested for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.
The flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to grab a treat before they close.
